```{r}
# Set up the packages and read the data
library(tidyverse)

fmr <- read_csv(
  "fmr2027.csv",
  col_types = cols(
    fips = col_character(),
    stusps = col_character(),
    state = col_character(),
    countyname = col_character(),
    county_town_name = col_character(),
    hud_area_code = col_character(),
    hud_area_name = col_character(),
    metro = col_integer(),
    pop2024 = col_double(),
    bedrooms = col_integer(),
    fmr = col_double()
  )
)
```

```{r}
# Prepare the variables used in the graphs
fmr <- fmr |>
  mutate(
    metro = factor(metro, levels = c(0, 1),
                   labels = c("nonmetro", "metro")),
    record_type = if_else(str_ends(fips, "99999"),
                          "county code", "sub-county code")
  )

# Each HUD area has one rent for each bedroom size. Keep one of each.
area_rents <- fmr |>
  distinct(hud_area_code, hud_area_name, metro, bedrooms, fmr)

area_2br <- area_rents |>
  filter(bedrooms == 2)

records_2br <- fmr |>
  filter(bedrooms == 2)
```

```{r}
#| output: false
# A few checks from the first pass through the data

dim(fmr)
str(fmr)
colSums(is.na(fmr))
sum(duplicated(fmr))
fmr |> count(fips, bedrooms) |> filter(n > 1)
fmr |> count(fips) |> count(n)
fmr |> filter(bedrooms == 2, pop2024 == 0) |> count(stusps)
fmr |>
  group_by(hud_area_code, bedrooms) |>
  summarise(n_rents = n_distinct(fmr), .groups = "drop") |>
  filter(n_rents > 1)
```

```{r}
#| label: figure-1
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 5.4
# Distribution of two-bedroom Fair Market Rents

ggplot(area_2br, aes(x = fmr)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 50, boundary = 0) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  labs(x = "fmr ($)", y = "count", caption = "Figure 1") +
  theme_minimal(12)
```

```{r}
#| label: figure-2
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 5.4
# Fair Market Rent by bedroom count

ggplot(area_rents, aes(x = factor(bedrooms), y = fmr)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.alpha = 0.35, outlier.size = 0.7) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  labs(x = "bedrooms", y = "fmr ($)", caption = "Figure 2") +
  theme_minimal(12)
```

```{r}
#| label: figure-3
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 5.5
# Compare each bedroom size with the same area's two-bedroom rent

rent_wide <- area_rents |>
  select(hud_area_code, bedrooms, fmr) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = bedrooms, values_from = fmr,
              names_prefix = "br")

bedroom_ratios <- rent_wide |>
  transmute(
    hud_area_code,
    `0` = br0 / br2,
    `1` = br1 / br2,
    `3` = br3 / br2,
    `4` = br4 / br2
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -hud_area_code,
    names_to = "bedrooms",
    values_to = "ratio"
  ) |>
  mutate(bedrooms = factor(bedrooms, levels = c("0", "1", "3", "4")))

ggplot(bedroom_ratios, aes(x = ratio)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.01, boundary = 0) +
  facet_wrap(~bedrooms, ncol = 2) +
  labs(x = "fmr / fmr (2 bedrooms)", y = "count", caption = "Figure 3") +
  theme_minimal(12)
```

```{r}
#| label: figure-4
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 5.2
# Compare two-bedroom rents for metro and nonmetro HUD areas

ggplot(area_2br, aes(x = metro, y = fmr)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.alpha = 0.35, outlier.size = 0.7) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  labs(x = "metro", y = "fmr ($)", caption = "Figure 4") +
  theme_minimal(12)
```

```{r}
#| label: figure-5
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 8.2
# Two-bedroom FMR across states; each point is a HUD area

state_areas <- records_2br |>
  distinct(hud_area_code, stusps, metro, fmr) |>
  mutate(stusps = fct_reorder(stusps, fmr, .fun = median))

ggplot(state_areas, aes(x = fmr, y = stusps)) +
  geom_point(
    aes(colour = metro),
    alpha = 0.65,
    size = 1.3,
    position = position_jitter(width = 0, height = 0.15, seed = 1)
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  labs(x = "fmr ($)", y = "stusps", colour = "metro", caption = "Figure 5") +
  theme_minimal(12)
```

```{r}
#| label: figure-6
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 5.8
# Population and two-bedroom FMR, separated by record type
# Zero-population records are shown in Figure 8; a log axis cannot show zero.

ggplot(filter(records_2br, pop2024 > 0), aes(x = pop2024, y = fmr)) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = metro), alpha = 0.45, size = 1.2) +
  facet_wrap(~record_type) +
  scale_x_log10(breaks = c(10, 1000, 100000, 10000000),
                labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  labs(x = "pop2024", y = "fmr ($)", colour = "metro", caption = "Figure 6") +
  theme_minimal(12)
```

```{r}
#| label: figure-7
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 4.8
# Missing town names by record type

name_status <- records_2br |>
  mutate(county_town_name = if_else(
    is.na(county_town_name), "missing", "present"
  ))

ggplot(name_status, aes(x = record_type, fill = county_town_name)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent()) +
  labs(x = "record_type", y = "proportion", fill = "county_town_name",
       caption = "Figure 7") +
  theme_minimal(12)
```

```{r}
#| label: figure-8
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 4.8
# Geographic records with zero population

zero_pop <- records_2br |>
  filter(pop2024 == 0) |>
  count(stusps) |>
  mutate(stusps = fct_reorder(stusps, n))

ggplot(zero_pop, aes(x = n, y = stusps)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(x = "count", y = "stusps", caption = "Figure 8") +
  theme_minimal(12)
```

```{r}
#| label: figure-9
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 8.2
# Geographic records and distinct HUD areas by state

state_counts <- records_2br |>
  group_by(stusps) |>
  summarise(
    records = n_distinct(fips),
    hud_areas = n_distinct(hud_area_code),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(records, hud_areas),
    names_to = "unit",
    values_to = "count"
  ) |>
  mutate(stusps = fct_reorder(stusps, count, .fun = max))

ggplot(state_counts, aes(x = count, y = stusps)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = stusps), colour = "grey70") +
  geom_point(aes(colour = unit), size = 1.8) +
  scale_x_log10(breaks = c(1, 3, 10, 30, 100, 300)) +
  labs(x = "count", y = "stusps", colour = "unit", caption = "Figure 9") +
  theme_minimal(12)
```

```{r}
#| label: figure-10
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 7.4
# Highest and lowest two-bedroom rents, with each area's full rent schedule

extreme_codes <- bind_rows(
  area_2br |> arrange(fmr) |> slice_head(n = 10),
  area_2br |> arrange(fmr) |> slice_tail(n = 10)
) |>
  pull(hud_area_code)

extreme_names <- area_2br |>
  filter(hud_area_code %in% extreme_codes) |>
  arrange(fmr) |>
  pull(hud_area_name) |>
  str_remove(" HUD Metro FMR Area")

extreme_areas <- area_rents |>
  filter(hud_area_code %in% extreme_codes) |>
  mutate(
    hud_area_name = str_remove(hud_area_name, " HUD Metro FMR Area"),
    hud_area_name = factor(hud_area_name, levels = extreme_names),
    bedrooms = factor(bedrooms)
  )

ggplot(extreme_areas, aes(x = fmr, y = hud_area_name, colour = bedrooms)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.8) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  labs(x = "fmr ($)", y = "hud_area_name", colour = "bedrooms",
       caption = "Figure 10") +
  theme_minimal(12)
```
